text: 11月2日，中共中央政治局委员、中央外办主任王毅在北京会见伊朗最高国家安全委员会副秘书巴盖里，同沙特国务大臣、内阁成员、国家安全顾问艾班举行会谈。 在会见巴盖里时，王毅表示，当前中东地区战事延宕、外溢扩散，对话谈判才是解决之道。中方愿秉持习近平主席就缓和中东局势提出的一系列倡议和主张，同各方一道继续为恢复地区和平作出努力。中方支持伊朗维护自身主权和安全，愿推动中伊关系继续发展。 巴盖里表示，伊方赞赏习近平主席提出的倡议主张和中方维护多边主义的一贯立场，期待中方为国际地区和平发挥更重要作用。 在同艾班会谈时，艾班转交了沙特王储兼首相穆罕默德就双边关系发展和
text_en: On November 2, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Director of the Office of the Central Commission for Foreign Affairs, met in Beijing with Bagheri, Deputy Secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, and held talks with Saudi Minister of State, Cabinet Member and National Security Advisor Aliban. During the meeting with Bagheri, Wang Yi said that with fighting in the Middle East dragging on and spilling over, dialogue and negotiation are the only way to resolve the issue. China is willing to uphold the series of initiatives and propositions put forward by President Xi Jinping on easing the situation in the Middle East and, together with all parties, continue efforts to restore regional peace. China supports Iran in safeguarding its sovereignty and security and is willing to promote the continued development of China-Iran relations. Bagheri said Iran appreciates the initiatives and propositions put forward by President Xi Jinping and China's consistent position of upholding multilateralism, and looks forward to China playing a greater role in international and regional peace.
